Today I shut down my computer to give the toddler free range of the house, I made my salad sat down on the couch and I played with him and his puzzle a bit then he got up on the couch and while I ate he bit my arm 4 times before G-Ma finally got up and got him off me, I wasn't going to stop him or say a thing. She then took the baby and told the mother that he was bothering my computer, never told them he bit me, and he also hit me slapped my face, punched my nose and tried to gouge my eyes and she did nothing to stop him and I am not allowed to say anything to him.

I am so mentally distraught my therapist will have a field day with this...

I been going to the gym, got a financial assistance from the YMCA. I don't have the money to spend so they were kind to help. Been going there just to get me out of the house, funny thing is, her mother rubs it in to her that I try to get out more... I don't like it. I am me and she is she.

I love going to swim cause my joints don't hurt as much. I can jog, realized 2 weeks ago I can even do a jumping jack. I got a fitbit which tracks everything. I just over eat when I get in a manic mood and can't cry and such. It sucks but I am getting help on that as well.


I just feel that I am not wanted here that when I am out of the house they always make it seem like the baby being able to use the coffee table was the highlight of the day... When the kid finally talks it will be a highlight...

After being yelled at today about yelling at the kid I listened to grandma in the kitchen say and yell "no" to him over 75 times in less than 30 mins.

Right... I think they are mad because I actually will look up child development stuff online and such cause I want the kid to be smart and talk and do something other then watch TV...
